game_title: Infinite Loop Trap – Bat Hollow Defense
game_concept: A tower defense set in Shadow Cave – Bat Hollow, a hollow of roosting bats: the cave miner must handle glow-eyed lurkers while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Infinite Loop Trap: Find the missing update line that makes a loop never stop, before glow-eyed lurkers overload Bat Hollow.
theme: Shadow Cave – Bat Hollow: a hollow of roosting bats
core_gameplay_loop: In Bat Hollow, repeat each round: Find the missing update line that makes a loop never stop, before glow-eyed lurkers overload Bat Hollow. Each round, glow-eyed lurkers strike the exit ledge, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the loop_safety value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the exit ledge from glow-eyed lurkers in Bat Hollow: keep the loop_safety meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 30-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: loop_safety drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 30-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 1 (intro tier): Infinite Loop Trap
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

code_snippet:
while n < 5:
    print(n)  # n never changes
tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how loop_safety changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against glow-eyed lurkers in Bat Hollow.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 30 seconds while loop_safety > 0.
